title: Who Owns Costco? Shareholders and Membership
dek: A sourced first draft distinguishing Costco shareholders from members. The current owner table remains under research.
answer: Costco Wholesale Corporation is a public company owned by shareholders. Membership is a customer relationship, not an equity stake.

paragraphs.heading: Shareholders and members are different relationships
paragraphs: Costco Wholesale Corporation is a public company owned by shareholders. Its shares trade under the ticker COST. Buying membership gives a customer access to Costco’s stores and services; buying common stock makes an investor a shareholder.

[Costco’s stock information](https://investor.costco.com/stock-info/default.aspx) describes its shares and shareholder services. The [fiscal 2026 annual filing](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/909832/000090983226000093/cost-20260830.htm) points readers to proxy disclosures for detailed beneficial ownership.

paragraphs.heading: Reporting still required
paragraphs: A dated beneficial-owner table, founder history and voting-control explanation remain under research. This is a short reporting draft, not a complete ownership investigation.

title: Who Owns ALDI in the United States?
dek: A reporting draft establishing the ALDI SOUTH group relationship while tracing the unresolved ultimate-control structure.
answer: In the United States, ALDI belongs to the ALDI SOUTH Group. That group relationship alone does not establish ultimate ownership percentages or legal control.

paragraphs.heading: Start with the US business
paragraphs: The [ALDI US human-rights page](https://corporate.aldi.us/corporate-sustainability/supply-chain/human-rights) identifies the business as part of the ALDI SOUTH Group. [ALDI’s history](https://corporate.aldi.us/about-us/aldi-history) provides company-reported historical context. These pages establish a group relationship and a reporting trail, not a current cap table.

paragraphs.heading: Reporting still required
paragraphs: Ultimate control, foundation and trust structures, and the separate Trader Joe’s legal chain require original evidence. Exact stakes remain unestablished. This is an opening reporting draft.
